title: Command Shell Immersive Visual Polish
purpose: Make VedaPath feel like a premium, calm, source-first product world without adding clutter or reducing usability.
visual_principles: Bhagwa remains the primary action signal, used with restraint.
Peacock green signals source trust, safety, and steadiness.
Sacred gold supports warmth, progress, and quiet emphasis.
The side rail should feel grounded and premium, not heavy.
Typography should feel powerful but disciplined, with fewer oversized headings.
Cards and panels should feel calm, tactile, and readable.
The product should feel distinctive without becoming decorative.

surface_rules.corner_radius: 8px maximum for shell cards and controls
surface_rules.background: warm ivory with subtle woven texture and green-ivory wash
surface_rules.rail: deep green, warm brown, and restrained indigo
surface_rules.buttons: Bhagwa primary, green safe, ivory default

guardrails: Do not make the palette one-note saffron.
Do not add decorative orbs, blobs, or bokeh.
Do not hide the source-first product flow behind visual drama.
Do not imply spiritual authority, permission, authorization, or execution.
next_release: Controlled permission execution authorization draft gate
